report.summary: CONTENT seam fixed (uncommitted): added [oploc1,burgh_inn_climb_over] to quest_darknessofhallowvale/scripts/doh_burgh.rs2. The Burgh de Rott inn's Broken wall (loc 12737, m54_50 '0 35 30: 12737 0 1', on the north edge of 3491,3230) now climbs one tile along z with ~agility_exactmove(agility_shortcut_wall_jump): northward into the trapdoor room needs base Agility 10 (mesbox 'You need an Agility level of 10 to attempt this.' otherwise), southward needs no level, and each crossing gives 0.5 Agility XP (stat_advance 5). Source: OSRS wiki 'Broken wall (Burgh de Rott)' (object 12737: Climb-over; Agility 10 to the basement/northward, none southward, 0.5 XP regardless of direction); Quest Helper DarknessOfHallowvale climbOverBrokenWall (3491,3230,0) and trapdoorRoom zone 3489..3491,3231..3232; wiki In Aid of the Myreque quick guide 'Enter the pub, climb over the broken wall'. The refusal sentence is the tree's standard agility wording; the wiki quotes no message. Proof: scratch build/seam_state/vm-b1-seam2/doh_wall/doh_wall_seam.lua, run doh_wall_seam. Before the fix: climb.low.refused 'tile 3491,3230,0 msgs: Nothing interesting happens.' and climbOverBrokenWall.north FAIL 'tile 3491,3230,0 msgs: Nothing interesting happens.'. After: SUMMARY PASS 12/0, including climb.low.refused 'tile 3491,3230,0 ... chat=mesbox' (Agility 9, shot 003 shows the mesbox), climbOverBrokenWall.north 'tile 3491,3231,0' (shot 005 shows the player inside the room), climbOverBrokenWall.back.south 'tile 3491,3230,0', climbOverBrokenWall.pair_xp 'agility: +1 xp (whole units)' (two crossings at 0.5 each; the client's whole-xp field cannot show one), climbOverBrokenWall.south.tile 'tile 3491,3230,0 (Agility 1: no level southward)'. Copy of the committed test with t.blocked removed plus the guide's next step (build/seam_state/vm-b1-seam2/doh_wall/darknessofhallowvale.lua, run doh_wall_copy): climbOverBrokenWall.reading PASS 'tile 3491,3231,0'. It then stops at the next guide step, enterBurghPubBasement: op1 opens the trapdoor ('You clear the rubble and open the trapdoor.'), but Climb-down answers 'You can't go any further.' and leaves the player at 3491,3232,0. Regressions: cooks_assistant 48/0 and druid 30/0 green under gate.py (--no-build --no-publish); check-drive-abi and check-pt-switch PASS. No C change. The only committed test that uses the symbol is darknessofhallowvale.

darknessofhallowvale stays blocked: its t.blocked reason (no wall handler) is gone, but the leg now stops one step later at the trapdoor. The author or relay should move t.blocked to enterBurghPubBasement with the climb_shared.rs2:37 finding.
The Agility refusal text follows the tree's convention. The wiki page does not quote the in-game message.

Re the user's question in this run's request: yes, .git is what takes the disk. /home/user/oldschool-clientc/.git is 9.1 GB of the 252 GB disk (3.0 GB free). 8.0 GB of that is .git/modules/OSRS-Content: a shallow clone with 881 commits but 6 packfiles totalling 7.84 GiB (1.7 to 2.7 GB each, all written 2026-10-01/02, so each fetch added its own pack). Note that packs are deduplicated only by a repack. Nothing was changed. A 'git -C .git/modules/OSRS-Content repack -ad' or a narrower refetch (--depth 1, a single branch, or a partial clone with --filter=blob:none) would likely reclaim most of it. A repack needs temporary space about the size of the result, so it is risky at 3 GB free. It is the owner's call.
doc_notes: seam-facts or gaps-world: the Burgh de Rott Broken wall (burgh_inn_climb_over) sits on the north edge of 3491,3230. It crosses 3491,3230 <-> 3491,3231 and needs Agility 10 northward only. Each crossing gives 0.5 XP, which t.skill.expect_gain cannot see; read a pair of crossings as +1.
A trapdoor bound to ~climb_ladder(-1) on plane 0 answers 'You can't go any further.'. An underground basement (z+6400) needs ~climb_ladder_to with an explicit coord.
